Skald is developed on **GitLab** ([dunn.dev/skald.md](https://gitlab.com/dunn.dev/skald.md)) -- that is where CI, code review, and the roadmap live. This GitHub repo is a mirror for discoverability. PRs here are welcome and will be ported to GitLab where CI and review happen. For the fastest path, open a Merge Request on GitLab directly.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for dev setup and check gates.
